reason: First grade is a year away and I want my child doing letters and numbers in English and Uzbek every day, and 25 thousand a month is nothing next to Kinopoisk. I'd start on the free version, and if the child actually uses it for a week or two I'd pay for one month of PRO with Payme to see what's in it, not the year.
objection: If the download is huge it will eat our mobile data and take forever, and I don't know what PRO adds over the free part. If the free version already covers the basics, why pay?
would_change_my_mind: If the download is large and the offline mode doesn't really work on our connection, I'd delete it and not pay anything.
